latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of kuaishou-lifeservice-merchant (快手生活服务-商家经营助手).

- Provides merchants with the ability to query products, merchant stores, staff, official accounts, sub-accounts, and business operation data.
- Includes account configuration and switching support for multiple merchants.
- Offers a set of scripts for querying brand qualifications, staff info, transaction data, evaluations, incentives, contracts, products, and more.
- Features clear error handling and usage examples for all major merchant management functions.
- Supports fast authorization and onboarding for developers and merchants via the Kuaishou Open Platform.
